description: Estimate how strong a password really is, the way attackers guess (zxcvbn-style): finds common passwords (1,282-entry list), dictionary words (also reversed, capitalised or l33t), keyboard walks, sequences, repeats, years and dates, then the cheapest way to guess the whole thing. Returns a 0–4 score, entropy bits, guesses, crack time for 4 attack scenarios, the pieces found, and advice. Offline only: no breach lookups, nothing stored or logged. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/password-check/

password.description: The password to check (only the first 256 characters are analysed in detail).

showPieces.description: Include the matched pieces (they contain parts of the password).

name: password_check
title: Password strength check
